description: This file defines a TinyMCE plugin named 'Preview', including methods for initializing plugin info, generating control HTML, executing commands related to preview functionality, and embedding media for previews. It interacts with TinyMCE's core functions and the DOM to facilitate content previewing.

methods.name: getInfo()
methods.description: Returns metadata about the plugin, including name, author, version, and relevant URLs.

methods.name: getControlHTML(cn)
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the preview control button.

methods.name: execCommand(editor_id, element, command, user_interface, value)
methods.description: Executes the preview command, either opening a preview window with a specified URL or a generated HTML preview.

methods.name: _setDoc
methods.description: Stores a reference to the document object of the preview window.

methods.name: _setWin
methods.description: Stores a reference to the preview window object.

methods.name: _onLoad
methods.description: Handles post-load tasks in the preview window, such as inserting embedded media elements.

methods.name: _writeFlash
methods.description: Embeds Flash content into the preview.

methods.name: _writeShockWave
methods.description: Embeds ShockWave content into the preview.

methods.name: _writeQuickTime
methods.description: Embeds QuickTime media into the preview.

methods.name: _writeRealMedia
methods.description: Embeds RealMedia content into the preview.

methods.name: _writeWindowsMedia
methods.description: Embeds Windows Media Player content into the preview.

methods.name: _writeEmbed
methods.description: Creates an object/embed HTML snippet for embedded media.
